column3: (3)  (a)  Every  office  bearer  of  the  Board  including  the
patrons and advisers, shall be appointed or elected for a period
of three years and any such office bearer, patron or advisor
shall be eligible for re-appointment or re-election after lapse

column2: of the said period of three years.

column3: (b) In the event of a vacancy occuring due to the death,
resignation, incapacity or removal from office of an office
bearer, the Board shall, having regard to the rules of the body
corporate, elect or appoint a person to fill such vacancy.
(c) The person elected or appointed under paragraph (b)
shall  hold  office  for  the  unexpired  portion  of  the  term  of
office of the member whom he succeeds.
